title: Vibhuti Pada
summary: The third chapter describes the deeper meditative states of Dharana, Dhyana, and Samadhi, and the extraordinary powers (Vibhutis) that can arise from their mastery.

verses.translation: Dharana is the binding of the mind to one place, object or idea.
verses.meaning: desha - place; bandhash - binding; chittasya - of the mind; dharana - concentration

verses.translation: The continuous flow of cognition towards that object is Dhyana (Meditation).
verses.meaning: tatra - there; pratyaya - cognition; ekatanata - continuous flow; dhyanam - meditation

verses.translation: When that same meditation shines forth with the object alone and the self is as if empty of its own form, that is Samadhi.
verses.transliteration: tad eva arthamātra-nirbhāsaṁ svarūpa-śūnyam iva samādhiḥ
verses.meaning: tat - that; eva - itself; arthamatra - only the object; nirbhasam - shining forth...
